purpose: Assistant-led Phoenix/Tucson completion of the supportive and affordable housing operator lane.
safety: Inventory seed only. No outreach is staged or sent. Do not infer service need from resident vulnerability. Protect confidential client/shelter information and qualify purchasing authority before outreach.
